lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Six vertical line segments are visible; the four central lines exhibit high contrast and relatively uniform spacing, while the anterior and posterior-most lines are faint and less defined.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most and posterior-most lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal ridge or ventral fringe areas.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular white spots are visible on the posterior flank/upper haunch area, positioned on a horizontal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, spiraling upwards and posteriorly from the skull before curving medially at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.3 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips account for approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings including a chevron between the eyes and dual spots on the lower cheek; presence of a long dark ventral hair fringe and a white-tipped dorsal mane.
